 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 34.6 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, 1 run, tossed up and sliding into the right-hander, catches Taylor's inside edge on the flick and lobs off the pad to short third 34.5 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, the paddle from Taylor - gets down low and laps it straight to the fielder at short fine 34.4 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, an inside out chipped drive, but Ervine doesn't get the placement and it's a single to deep cover 34.3 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, 1 run, tossed up on off, driven down to long-on for a single 34.2 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, fraction short and on off - Ervine makes room and punches it square on the off-side for a single 34.1 4 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, FOUR , nicely played , a gentle full-toss from Mosaddek and Ervine doesn't miss out - bends down low and then sweeps it behind square on the on-side for a boundary 22.6 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, tossed up and full, Ervine eases it to long-off 22.5 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, no run, drifting in towards middle, blunted to midwicket 22.5 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, wide , fired down leg, Ervine flicks and misses. He loses his balance slightly and the keeper breaks the stumps. There's an appeal for stumping and the TV umpire has been summoned. Ervine is safe 22.4 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, 1 run, leg-lined, worked through square leg. 100 up for Zimbabwe 22.3 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, 93.1kph, turns this fullish ball to midwicket 22.2 4 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, FOUR , cracking shot! 84.6kph, on a length with width on offer. Taylor slightly stays low and lets his hands do the rest. Slashes hard to slap it through the covers 22.1 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, 2 runs, 97.4kph, full delivery, clipped through square leg 20.6 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, Mosaddek has his hands on head. 98.4kph, not only does he bowl a quicker one, he also bowls it very full. Taylor gets forward and yorks himself. Doesn't connect and luckily for him, the ball misses the leg-stump by an inch or so. He was also outside the crease however the keeper couldn't grab it cleanly 20.5 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, slightly short outside off, cut to deep point 20.4 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, no run, 89.8kph, Ervine shuffles and gets low to sweep, inside-edges towards short fine leg 20.3 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, 1 run, 88.7kph, full on middle, Taylor backs away early to flick it to deep square leg 20.2 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, 89.1kph, full ball, clipped to midwicket 20.1 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, 87kph, flat ball on a short of length, Ervine punches to long-off 17.6 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, floated up outside off, Ervine steps out of his crease, moves leg-side in the process, reaches out and drives along the ground to long-off 17.5 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, no run, drifting in towards middle-leg and Ervine blocks it back to Mosaddek 17.4 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, 1 run, more flight and fuller, driven down to long-on 17.3 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, 89.4kph, length ball, punched to short midwicket 17.2 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, appeal for lbw, turned down by the umpire. Towhid Hridoy has a chat with his keeper and bowler, signals 'T' at the last second. Taylor attempts the reverse-sweep against a very full ball. Did it come off the glove/under-edge? Flat line on UltraEdge, which confirms that the ball sneaked under the blade. Over to ball-tracking and the impact is outside off. Bangladesh lose a review 17.1 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, non-turner, wristily clipped to the left of short midwicket and Shanto makes a diving stop 15.6 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, 2 runs, driven through extra cover 15.5 4 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, FOUR , second boundary of the over! Shorter, straighter and that's been put away. Taylor walks across, gets inside the line and helps it on its way to the left of the short fine leg fielder. Even the man in the deep - running to his right - can't cut it off 15.4 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, hint of inward spin from a length and Taylor defensively pushes it to midwicket 15.3 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, full outside off, Taylor blocks off the front foot 15.2 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, Mosaddek goes full and Ervine push-drives to long-off 15.1 4 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, FOUR , shout of ' catch it ' from Nurul Hasan. Fraction short, Ervine quickly treks back and heaves it to the left of the mid-on fielder. No one's catching/stopping that 13.6 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, eases the drive to long-off and keeps the strike with a single 13.5 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, no run, fullish ball, blocked 13.4 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, 1 run, Taylor goes through with the premeditative sweep shot even though it's been darted towards leg. Manages to bring his bat down just in time to get some wood on it. The ball dribbles towards point 13.3 Mosaddek Hossain to Brendan Taylor, no run, 85.8kph, flat ball on a length around off, nudged into the leg-side 13.2 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, 1 run, 87.4kph, too full and Ervine drives it along the ground to long-off 13.1 Mosaddek Hossain to Ervine, no run, round the wicket, tossed up ball drifting in towards leg with a slip in place.
